data: Which line on the graph titled "Cross validation (BF08)" has the highest value when the number of hidden states is 15?

The question asks which line on the graph titled "Cross validation (BF08)" has the highest value when the number of hidden states is 15. From the caption, we know that the graph shows cross-validated log-likelihood values for different model orders and numbers of hidden states. The lines represent three different model orders: 0th-order GMM, 1st-order HMM, and 2nd-order HMM. 

Looking at the graph labeled "Cross validation (BF08)", we can see three lines corresponding to these model orders. At the point where the number of hidden states is 15, the red line (representing 1st-order HMM) appears to have the highest value among the three lines. Therefore, the answer is the red line.
